metadata.Name: SQuAD 2.0
metadata.Description: This paper presents SQuAD 2.0, a new dataset that combines answerable questions from the previous version of SQuAD (SQuAD 1.1) with 53,775 new, unanswerable questions about the same paragraphs. Crowdworkers crafted these questions so that they are relevant to the paragraph, and the paragraph contains a plausible answer. The dataset is designed to challenge models to understand when a question cannot be answered given the context.
metadata.Paper Title: Know What You Don't Know: Unanswerable Questions for SQuAD
metadata.Abstract: Machine reading comprehension has become a central task in natural language understanding, fueled by the creation of many large-scale datasets. In this work, we construct SQuAD 2.0, a new dataset that combines answerable questions from the previous version of SQuAD (SQuAD 1.1) with 53,775 new, unanswerable questions about the same paragraphs. Crowdworkers crafted these questions so that (1) they are relevant to the paragraph, and (2) the paragraph contains a plausible answer. We confirm that SQuAD 2.0 is both challenging and high-quality. A state-of-the-art model achieves only 66.3 F1 on the test set, whereas human accuracy is 89.5 F1. We are optimistic that SQuAD 2.0 will encourage the development of reading comprehension systems that know what they don't know.
